text:
ellen: Heads-up: new hire Hiro (SWE) starts Monday at Tokyo hub. Passport expires May 2. We need I-9 verification and same-day badge.

casey: For I-9 it must be unexpired on verification date. Two paths: mobile notary or hub-authorized verifier. Mobile notary earliest 08:30 JST.

ellen: If we do 08:30 notary, can security hand off a temporary badge around 10:30?

hiro: 08:30 works for me.

casey: Yes, security can issue a day-1 temp badge once they receive: passport photo page (scan), notary attestation PDF or verifier note, and signed badge policy. ETA after intake ~45-60 min.

it-ops-bot: Security ticket created: SEC-2389. Badge pickup code will be posted to this thread after provisioning.

ellen: Checklist for Hiro (I'll DM link to secure upload):
- passport photo page (color scan)
- mobile notary attestation OR hub verifier note (PDF)
- signed badge policy (e-sign OK)
- pickup window (10:30-11:30 JST)

casey: Also flagging visas team since passport expiry is within 90 days. People-ops will follow up if anything else needed.

hiro: Uploaded passport scan and signed policy. Thanks everyone!

ellen: Got it, forwarding to security. Will post pickup code once ready. :thumbsup:
